about: Owner-editable guardrails read by Scripts/model-bench.py (make bench-models). Edit a number here; no code changes. 'gated': true means a failing or unmeasured value stops a candidate from passing that role; false means it is reported only. 'status' records who decided the number: 'decided' is an owner decision with a date, 'proposed' is a default nobody has confirmed yet. The reference machine is a 16 GB / 256 GB M2-M3 MacBook Air with ASR and voice running; a run on any other machine, or under contention, is a diagnostic and never passes.

reference_machine.owner_note: 2026-10-04 decision: a benchmark on this machine picks the silent default, never the user.

decode_tps_p10.label: Decode speed floor (p10 of 10 fixed 256-token runs, under ASR load)

sustained_last_minute_tps.label: Decode speed in the last minute of a 10 minute sustained run

warm_ttft_s.label: Warm first token on the voice route, under a full voice turn (C2)
warm_ttft_s.measured_by: C2 voice turn. --floor reports C2=UNMEASURED today (PL-01 item 3 is open), so this is recorded as unmeasured and the median warm first-token time of the C1 rounds is shown for information only. Set gated to false to ignore it until C2 is wired.

peak_footprint_gb.label: Peak app memory (physical footprint of the self-test process)
peak_footprint_gb.measured_by: proc_pid_rusage polled once a second by the bench script

memory_target_gb.label: Memory challenge target (about 2 GB)
memory_target_gb.status: direction, not a cap (owner: a challenge, not a ceiling)

swap_growth_mb.label: Swap growth during the run
swap_growth_mb.measured_by: LLM_FLOOR swap_growth, else the bench script's own vm.swapusage samples

pressure_worst.label: Worst memory pressure seen stays normal

artifact_disk_gb.label: The language-model file stays small enough to ship by default
artifact_disk_gb.measured_by: file size on disk (Apple's built-in model is OS-resident and exempt)

cleanup_failed_assertions_max.label: Dictation cleanup: failed assertions over the cleanup corpus

cleanup_p50_s.label: Dictation cleanup: median seconds per cleanup pass

notes_headings_missing_max.label: Meeting notes: every required section is present

notes_tps_min.label: Meeting notes: generated tokens per second (includes prompt reading, so lower than pure decode)

notes_quality_rubric.label: Meeting notes: factual quality against the predeclared rubric (SB-07)
notes_quality_rubric.status: open: the SB-07 corpus and rubric do not exist yet, so notes content is NOT graded here; reading the notes is a human step

isolation.about: Settings the bench must never change. Compared before and after every run; any difference stops the matrix and fails the report.

candidates.about: Display names the cleanup comparison uses for each installed file (matched by lower-case file name fragment). A file without an entry here has no cleanup row until the self-test learns its name.
